previous_to_current.evidence: “I was interrupted by an alarm… I had not finished gathering my thoughts when there was a sudden violent lurch” – the alarm sounds while the interview is still in progress.

current_to_next.evidence: Next scene opens with “Months later… twenty diurnals after the attack”.

individual.pysical_properties: quadrupedal alien with synthetic fabric covering, cybernetic communication implant
individual.description: The customs and immigration officer conducting the interview; later wounded, loses an arm and receives a prosthetic.

individual.pysical_properties: quadriform biped, short coarse brown fur, cybernetic communication implant, high‑gravity musculature
individual.description: Abductee pre‑Contact human specimen; displays superhuman resilience during the Hunter attack.

collective.description: Six alien combatants; ceramic‑white skin, seven eyes, six legs, cybernetically fused pulse guns, full military combat harnesses.

object.material: metallic alloy with integrated energy core
object.purpose: directed‑energy weapon used by both officer and Hunters
object.description: Standard‑issue station security pulse gun, auto‑configures to the user’s species.

object.purpose: project a protective energy shield around the wearer
object.description: Worn on the officer’s harness; activates with a power dock.

object.purpose: emit a disabling neuro‑pulse to incapacitate organic targets
object.description: Stored in the weapons locker; only two rounds remain during the fight.
Opens automatically when the officer’s security harness broadcasts the correct codes.

location.name: Outlook on Forever – Customs Area
location.description: The interview corral and adjacent customs booths where the alarm erupts and the firefight unfolds.

concept.description: Three short howls signalling an external assault on the station.
Long wail indicating structural damage to the station’s hull.
Continuous tone warning of internal system failures.

event.name: Hunter Attack
event.evidence: The scene describes the sudden alarm, the officer and Jenkins arming themselves, and the ensuing firefight with six Hunters.
